units.source_text: 我无法忍受老师无止境的无言的放任。

en.t: I could not endure the teacher's endless, silent indulgence.

units.source_text: 我只要还有一丁点人的感情，就无法不期待获得对方相应的感情。

en.t: As long as I still had even the slightest human feeling, I could not help expecting to receive a corresponding feeling from the other person.
Whether it was love or hatred.
